setlist_extra.title: An amazing aud tape for the time

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls it a no-nonsense early version, with the band starting to come together yet still fresh; Reviewer says it is a rare stand-alone Dark Star, not folded into a larger jam, and extremely good [6][13]
- **Death Don't Have No Mercy** (1 review): Reviewer found this version so strong they could replay it repeatedly [9]
- **Sitting On Top Of The World** (1 review): Raucous performance; afterward Jerry jokes they never played it well even when they were doing it [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **Born Cross Eyed**: rare: 14 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1968-03-29.sbd.miller.108993.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 9 songs; 61 min; rated 3.86/5 by 14 [1]
- **gd68-03-29.aud.vernon.9473.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 8 songs; 34 min; rated 4.28/5 by 18 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the sound quality as fantastic for a 1968 audience recording [10]
- **gd68-03-29.aud.cotsman.6029.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 4 songs; 29 min; rated 3.89/5 by 18 [3]. Said about its sound: Outstanding audience recording, often mistaken for a soundboard; it is all that circulates of this show; Audience tape that sounds great for 1968, with laid-back, deep-throated Garcia vocals; Vocals are clear and the music solid, despite flaws, for a roughly 40-year-old audience cassette that was remixed [3][6][13][14][15]

## Around the show

- Reviewer found this show rather dull next to other shows of the era and thinks 3/30 is far better [4]
- Reviewer owns both the 3/29 and 3/30 Carousel shows and likes them equally [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1968-03-29.sbd.miller.108993.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> (4 Track) Master Reels -> Dat (44.1k) [1]
- **gd68-03-29.aud.vernon.9473.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Raoul Duke and Matt Vernon; source: Audience [2]
- **gd68-03-29.aud.cotsman.6029.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience [3]. Also: Audience recording transferred through MR, D, PCM, D, CD, EAC to SHN; came via J. Cotsman to vine [3]
